usedFor: api.video holds the streams, and Google Docs keeps a log tab updated through “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “Live Stream Ended” in api.video, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: This trigger is pushed, so each ended broadcast reaches the doc tab without a scheduled-check delay.

watchOut: “Add or Replace Text In Tab” can replace a tab's existing content, so check it appends before logging every stream.
